name: cpu_vision_infer
title: Object detection on the CPU
short_description: Object detection model on bundled camera images, on the CPU.

structured_text.description: Runs an object detection network on a bundled set of camera images with ONNX Runtime on the processor, the way robots, cameras and edge devices without a capable GPU run perception. The model, image size and precision are fixed, and the run uses all cores.
structured_text.metric_explanation: The score is the number of images processed per second, from preprocessing to the final detections.
structured_text.value_interpretation: Higher is better. More images per second means a robot or camera system can watch more streams or react faster.
structured_text.reasoning: Detection networks stress vector math, memory bandwidth and cache reuse in convolution and attention layers, so this reflects how well a processor handles vision models without an accelerator.
